usedFor: Zoho CRM holds accounts and deals for companies that ship mobile apps, and Applyra tracks App Store and Google Play rankings. A “New Account” in Zoho CRM can run “Track App” in Applyra to start watching that customer's app.

bestTemplate.name: “New Account” in Zoho CRM, then “Track App” in Applyra
bestTemplate.why: A new account is the natural moment to begin rank tracking for a customer's app. “New Deals” works too, but a deal is not always a customer yet.

watchOut: “Track App” needs a store ID, a country and a language, which a CRM record may not carry. Both Zoho CRM triggers are polling, so tracking starts on a schedule.
